## Purpose
Describe the hardware/configuration change and why it is needed.

## Scope
- [ ] Smallest relevant change
- [ ] PCB/schematic/enclosure/ESPHome scope identified
- [ ] No unrelated cleanup

## Hardware / safety impact
- [ ] No electrical-safety impact
- [ ] Or affected power/isolation/connector/clearance assumptions documented

## Upstream / provenance
- [ ] Attribution preserved
- [ ] Existing docs/issues/open PRs checked for duplication

## Security
- [ ] No Wi-Fi/device/Home Assistant credentials committed

## Validation
List only checks actually performed, such as KiCad/ERC/DRC/KiBot/ESPHome validation.

## Review
Use `skills/pr-review-resolution/SKILL.md` for Codex findings.

Do not merge automatically.
